item.title: Wyoming Senate panel backs jail time for red flag law violations
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — Red flag violations in Wyoming could soon carry jail time after a Senate committee unanimously advanced a bill Thursday that adds criminal penalties to the state’s existing civil enforcement law.
